bio: Enjoy a relaxed and friendly environment at Macdonald Windsor Hotel's Caleys Restaurant. Set in the heart of Windsor, it is situated just two minutes from the gates of Windsor Castle and is the perfect place to rest in-between taking in attractions and shopping. The chefs at Caleys Restaurant use simple, fresh ingredients to create delicious flavours. Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea featuring sandwiches, warm fruit scones and a selection of sweet treats. Afternoon Tea is served in the comfortable Caleys lounge, or the restaurant on request. Set in the centre of Windsor, Macdonald Windsor Hotel is just five minutes' walk from Windsor & Eaton central station, and 40-minutes from London Paddington, or a 15-minute drive from London Heathrow airport.
